scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,open -c blue,magenta,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm:dev -w server" "npm:dev -w web" "node scripts/open-chrome.mjs http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:4000/api/health http://localhost:5173/"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.app: npm run build && concurrently -n app,open -c blue,green "npm:start" "node scripts/open-chrome.mjs http://localhost:4000"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
